# Beiz Data & Accounting

> AI, data and financial modelling for Australian businesses, led by Purav Mehta, an Australian Chartered Accountant and GAICD. Beiz connects a business's data, builds cash and job profit models, and sets up AI agents for routine finance work with limits, approvals and a decision log. A person approves anything that touches money, customers or decisions about people.

Key facts:
- Beiz Data & Accounting Pty Ltd, ABN 53 691 755 496. Led by Purav Mehta, Australian Chartered Accountant, GAICD. Based in Canberra, working Australia-wide.
- Fixed scope and fixed price, agreed in writing before work starts. Ways to start: AI workflow & controls sprint from $3,500 (two weeks: register of the AI tools a team uses, data map, named owners, use rules, a 90-day plan for the first controlled workflow, and a check of whether the Privacy Act automated-decision transparency rules starting 10 December 2026 apply; no ledger access needed), two-week cash & data check $1,500 fixed (credited if the client goes ahead), live cash & job profit model from $5,000, AI workforce setup from $6,000 (first agent), leave cover from $3,500 setup then from $2,000 a month, then monthly monitoring from $750 a month. Other work: quick wins from $1,200. Beiz is not registered for GST, so no GST is added to prices. A written proposal with the exact price follows within three business days.
- Independent: no software of its own to sell. Builds inside the client's own accounts (e.g. Xero, MYOB, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace) using AI plans whose terms exclude training on client data.
- Four disciplines: Data (reconciliation, reporting, forecasting), AI (automation with approval steps), Accounting (management reports, cash forecasts, financial and economic models, profit by job), Governance (board reporting, risk, AI use policy, Privacy Act automated-decision readiness).
- Also offered: a fixed-price billing review of three completed jobs. Timesheets, job list and invoices are reconciled from exports (no logins) into a findings register where each item is Confirmed, Needs information or Explained, with source records and arithmetic. Sample register (made-up data): https://beiz.com.au/assets/media/sample-findings.xlsx
- Typical clients: private-sector businesses of about 5 to 50 staff, especially project businesses that bill time or fixed fees (engineering, IT, consulting, trades).
- Does not provide tax agent, BAS agent, legal, audit or financial product advice services.
- Contact: hello@beiz.com.au, or book a discovery call at https://beiz.com.au/contact/
